Journey Mapping the Unmet Needs in Pediatric Adenoid Hypertrophy: A Caregiver's Perspective.

中文摘要

目的：系统绘制儿童腺样体肥大患儿及其照护者的患者旅程并识别未满足需求。方法：开展一项定性研究，对25名3-9岁儿童的照护者进行深度访谈。腺样体肥大经鼻内镜（阻塞≥70%）和/或多导睡眠监测（OAHI>1次/小时）确认。通过反思性主题分析构建综合旅程图。情绪曲线由照护者叙述定性推导，作为跨护理阶段情绪轨迹的启发式可视化，而非定量测量。结果：分析揭示两种不同的情绪轨迹：手术路径照护者因支持真空经历出院后危机，而保守治疗路径照护者因疗效不确定性承受持续焦虑。我们识别了路径特异性需求（出院后支持、疗效反馈）和跨领域需求（主动信息、整体习惯指导）。结论：该旅程图为制定针对性干预措施提供了循证框架，以指导照护者教育、出院计划、随访策略和多学科护理路径，解决关键系统故障并提升儿童腺样体肥大的以患者为中心的护理。

英文摘要

To systematically map the patient journey and identify unmet needs in children with adenoid hypertrophy and their caregivers. A qualitative study using in-depth interviews with 25 caregivers of children aged 3-9 years was conducted. Adenoid hypertrophy was confirmed by nasoendoscopy (≥70% obstruction) and/or polysomnography (OAHI >1 event/hour). Data were analyzed through reflexive thematic analysis to construct a comprehensive journey map. The emotional curve was derived qualitatively from caregiver narratives as a heuristic visualization of emotional trajectories across care stages, not as a quantitative measure. Analysis revealed two distinct emotional trajectories: surgical path caregivers experienced a post-discharge crisis due to support vacuum, while conservative path caregivers endured persistent anxiety from efficacy uncertainty. We identified both pathway-specific needs (post-discharge support, efficacy feedback) and cross-cutting needs (proactive information, holistic habit guidance). This journey mapping provides an evidence-based framework for developing targeted interventions to inform caregiver education, discharge planning, follow-up strategies, and multidisciplinary care pathways, addressing critical system failures and enhancing patient-centered care in pediatric adenoid hypertrophy.
